title: FinOpsAI Overview
description: Consolidated AI spend: what it costs, who owns it, and where it is heading. Money comes from Postgres because Prometheus counters reset on restart; live gauges come from Prometheus.

panels.title: Total AI spend this month
panels.description: Every source combined, month to date, with the change against the whole of last month.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_usd), 0) AS "Month to date"
FROM finops.cost_record
WHERE allocated = false
  AND occurred_at >= date_trunc('month', now());

SELECT round(100.0 * (curr - prev) / NULLIF(prev, 0), 1) AS "vs last month %"
FROM (
  SELECT
    coalesce(sum(amount_usd) FILTER (WHERE occurred_at >= date_trunc('month', now())), 0) AS curr,
    coalesce(sum(amount_usd) FILTER (
      WHERE occurred_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month'
        AND occurred_at <  date_trunc('month', now())
    ), 0) AS prev
  FROM finops.cost_record
  WHERE allocated = false
) t;

panels.title: Budget utilisation by team
panels.description: Live from the alert evaluator. Yellow at 80%, red once the budget is spent.

panels.title: Spend by source
panels.description: Tokens are the visible tip. This panel is the argument: compute, vector DB and infrastructure are the rest of the bill.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source AS metric, sum(amount_usd) AS value
FROM finops.cost_record
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  AND allocated = false
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY value DESC;

panels.title: Spend by team
panels.description: Stacked so the total is readable and each owner's share is visible. Allocated shared cost is counted on the child records, never twice.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, $__interval),
  team AS metric,
  sum(amount_usd) AS value
FROM finops.cost_record
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  AND allocated = false
GROUP BY 1, team
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Forecast: projected month end by team
panels.description: Month-to-date spend extrapolated at the observed run rate. Straight line, no seasonality -- early in a month it is extrapolating from very little.

targets.rawSql:
WITH mtd AS (
  SELECT team, sum(amount_usd) AS spend
  FROM finops.cost_record
  WHERE allocated = false
    AND occurred_at >= date_trunc('month', now())
  GROUP BY team
),
clock AS (
  SELECT
    GREATEST(
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - date_trunc('month', now()))) / 86400.0,
      0.0417
    ) AS elapsed_days,
    EXTRACT(
      EPOCH FROM ((date_trunc('month', now()) + interval '1 month') - date_trunc('month', now()))
    ) / 86400.0 AS total_days
)
SELECT
  mtd.team AS "Team",
  round(mtd.spend, 2) AS "Spend to date",
  round(mtd.spend / clock.elapsed_days * clock.total_days, 2) AS "Projected month end"
FROM mtd CROSS JOIN clock
ORDER BY 3 DESC;

panels.title: Unattributed spend (tagging debt)
panels.description: Spend that reached the warehouse with no owning team. Not an error -- this is the number that justifies the project. It should trend down as tagging improves.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, $__interval),
  sum(amount_usd) AS "Unattributed"
FROM finops.cost_record
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  AND allocated = false
  AND team = 'unattributed'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Cost per 1K tokens by model
panels.description: Efficiency, not volume. A model can be cheap per token and still dominate the bill, which is what the driver table shows.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  model AS "Model",
  round(sum(amount_usd) / NULLIF(sum(quantity), 0) * 1000, 6) AS "USD per 1K tokens",
  round(sum(quantity), 0) AS "Tokens",
  round(sum(amount_usd), 2) AS "Spend (USD)"
FROM finops.cost_record
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  AND allocated = false
  AND unit = 'tokens'
  AND model IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY model
HAVING sum(quantity) > 0
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Top 10 cost drivers
panels.description: The single most actionable panel: the model or resource, its team, and what it cost. Untagged spend appears with team 'unattributed'.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  coalesce(model, project) AS "Driver",
  source AS "Source",
  team AS "Team",
  round(sum(amount_usd), 2) AS "Spend (USD)"
FROM finops.cost_record
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  AND allocated = false
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 10;
